pirs.statement: Which coalition-formation path (continuity Tidö, broad-centre realignment, S-led minority, or hung/caretaker) will the 2026-09-13 result most plausibly open for the 2026–2030 mandate, given a ~176/173 starting arithmetic and L/MP threshold risk?
pirs.trigger: Any pre-poll bloc-defection signal or a published party red-line that closes one formation branch.

pirs.statement: Will both small governing partners (L and MP) clear the 4% spärr at the 2026-09-13 poll, since a single threshold failure collapses one or more of the four formation scenarios for the next mandate?
pirs.trigger: Any L or MP polling print below 4.0% inside the IMF-benign macro window.

pirs.statement: Will the macro backdrop entering the next mandate (IMF WEO Apr-2026 ~2.1% T+1 growth, ~34% gross debt T+1) stay benign enough that economic competence does NOT become the formation-decisive cleavage of the 2026–2030 government?
pirs.trigger: IMF-divergent CPI or unemployment breakout before the poll; a-kassa/pension salience HD10524/HD03130.

pirs.statement: Which inherited delivery files (equalisation HD10526, municipal health HD01SoU32, young offenders HD01JuU37) will most constrain the policy space of whichever 2026–2030 government forms?
pirs.trigger: Statskontoret or agency report documenting a structural implementation gap the next government must inherit.
